body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> iStation(representative Chae Jong-won) introduced premium mini Tablet 'Dude' at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA for 4 days from January 6.

5-inch mini Tab 'Dude' is loaded electrostatic touch display, 16/32GB memory, 3M pixel camera, G-sensor and GPS basically and supports Wi-Fi b/g/n, Bluetooth V2.1 + EDR, FM Radio, DMB and Office Document Viewer.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
